name: CrowdGen
work: AI data tasks that mostly need no technical background: rating, data collection, recordings, search evaluation and language projects.

source.title: RemoWork: 33 AI training platforms that pay (eligibility overview)

availability.note: CrowdGen is reported to be open in over 200 countries, but it publishes no list we could verify, so all African countries are unclear. A worker in Kenya was able to open an account, but has not yet been paid, so Kenya is not confirmed. Many projects are limited to people living in one specific country.

items.text: Individual projects often require you to live in a specific country and speak a specific language.
Workers report being paid through PayPal and Payoneer.
A Payoneer account used on the older Appen platform may need to be linked to your CrowdGen account.
CrowdGen is the new name for Appen's contributor platform. Check you are on the real crowdgen.com site before entering any details.
